
  // ADDITIVE LIFECYCLE CHECKS. Original 35 assertions above/below remain byte-identical.
  await present('interactive.html');await run('delay(250)');
  await run('window.lifecycleTrace=[];window.closedSource=doc().querySelector("iframe").contentWindow;window.closedFrame=doc().querySelector("iframe");window.closedTicks=0;addEventListener("message",e=>{if(e.source===closedSource&&e.data?.type==="heartbeat")closedTicks++});void 0');
  await run('(async()=>{const deadline=performance.now()+2000;while(closedTicks<2&&performance.now()<deadline)await delay(20);if(closedTicks<2)throw Error("Active exact iframe heartbeat probe did not start");lifecycleTrace.push({t:performance.now(),ticks:closedTicks,connected:closedFrame.isConnected,phase:"active"});document.querySelector("#closeBrowserSidebar").click();await delay(100)})()');
  await run('(async()=>{lifecycleTrace.push({t:performance.now(),ticks:closedTicks,connected:closedFrame.isConnected});await delay(240);lifecycleTrace.push({t:performance.now(),ticks:closedTicks,connected:closedFrame.isConnected})})()');
  await check('FIX-01 close removes exact HTML node, not just visibility','({oldConnected:closedFrame.isConnected,frameCount:doc()?.querySelectorAll("iframe").length,interactive:doc()?.classList.contains("is-interactive")})',{oldConnected:false,frameCount:0,interactive:false});
  await check('FIX-02 old WindowProxy heartbeats stop after queue grace','lifecycleTrace[2].ticks===lifecycleTrace[1].ticks',true);
  await run('ws.close();ws.close();delay()');await check('FIX-03 repeated close remains cleared','({open:ws.controller.isOpen(),frames:doc()?.querySelectorAll("iframe").length})',{open:false,frames:0});
  await run('window.bootCount=htmlMessages.filter(m=>m.data.type==="boot").length;window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"]",ctrlKey:true,shiftKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));delay(250)');
  await check('FIX-04 keyboard reopen makes new visible context with correct focus','({open:ws.controller.isOpen(),hidden:ws.controller.host.classList.contains("hidden"),newFrame:!!doc()?.querySelector("iframe")&&doc().querySelector("iframe")!==closedFrame,boots:htmlMessages.filter(m=>m.data.type==="boot").length>bootCount,focus:document.activeElement.id,source:doc()?.querySelector("iframe")?.src})',{open:true,hidden:false,newFrame:true,boots:true,focus:'closeBrowserSidebar',source:syntheticUrl});
  // Test every explicit entry following a close; fresh native bridge replies remain fixture-only.
  for(const mode of ['home','files','browser']){
    await run('ws.close()');
    if(mode==='home')await run('ws.openHome()');else await run(`ws.openMode(${JSON.stringify(mode)})`);
    if(mode==='files')await run('reply(pending.length-1,{files:[{path:"interactive.html",name:"interactive.html",size:100}]});delay()');
    await run('window.oldBootCount=htmlMessages.filter(m=>m.data.type==="boot").length;void 0');
    if(mode==='files'){await run('document.querySelector(".right-workspace-row-main").click();reply(pending.length-1,{file:files["interactive.html"]});delay(250)');}
    else {await present('interactive.html');await run('delay(250)');}
    await check('FIX-ENTRY '+mode+' reopens same HTML with a new execution','({active:ws.controller.getActiveModeId(),source:doc().querySelector("iframe")?.src,boots:htmlMessages.filter(m=>m.data.type==="boot").length>oldBootCount,focus:document.activeElement.id})',{active:'document',source:syntheticUrl,boots:true,focus:'closeBrowserSidebar'});
  }
  // A loading replacement is never eligible for replay; old HTML metadata must not resurrect.
  await run('window.delayed=ws.openLocalDocument("late.html",{sourceKind:"workspace-link",sessionId:"synthetic-A"});window.delayedIndex=pending.length-1;ws.close();window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"]",ctrlKey:true,shiftKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));reply(delayedIndex,{file:files["interactive.html"]});delayed;');await run('delay(180)');
  await check('FIX-05 late HTML response after close/reopen cannot revive old content','({frames:doc()?.querySelectorAll("iframe").length,loaded:doc()?.textContent.includes("试玩已载入")})',{frames:0,loaded:false});
  await present('interactive.html');await run('delay(200);');await run('ws.close();dispatchContext("synthetic-new-context");window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"]",ctrlKey:true,shiftKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));delay(180)');
  await check('FIX-06 context switch invalidates suspended HTML replay','doc()?.querySelectorAll("iframe").length',0);
  // Model receipts are invalidated by close; manual HTML replay must not reissue a nonce receipt.
  await run('window.modelWork=callbacks.model({nonce:"lifecycle-model-nonce",path:"interactive.html",sourceSessionId:"synthetic-A",file:{...files["interactive.html"],sourceSessionId:"synthetic-A"}});void 0');await run('delay(250)');
  await run('ws.close();callbacks.cancel({nonce:"lifecycle-model-nonce"});window.modelReplyCount=modelReplies.length;window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"]",ctrlKey:true,shiftKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}));delay(250)');
  await check('FIX-07 close/reopen never revives model nonce or recaptures','({state:ws.observeModelPreview("lifecycle-model-nonce").state,replies:modelReplies.slice(modelReplyCount).every(r=>r.state==="superseded")})',{state:'superseded',replies:true});
  await run('ws.close();ws.openMode("home")');await present('text.txt');await check('FIX-08 text reopening preserves exact inert text','text()',bodies['text.txt']);
  await run('ws.close();window.p=ws.openLocalDocument("failed.txt",{sourceKind:"workspace-link",sessionId:"synthetic-A"});reply(pending.length-1,null,"post-close error");p;');await check('FIX-09 post-close failure preserves alert and no active frame','({alert:doc()?.querySelector("[role=alert]")?.textContent,frames:doc()?.querySelectorAll("iframe").length})',{alert:'post-close error',frames:0});
  await present('interactive.html');await run('delay(200)');await run('ws.openMode("home");delay(100)');await run('window.detachedBeatCount=htmlMessages.filter(m=>m.data.type==="heartbeat").length;delay(180)');await check('FIX-10 mode switch stops detached app execution','htmlMessages.filter(m=>m.data.type==="heartbeat").length===detachedBeatCount',true);
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'lifecycle-trace.json'),JSON.stringify(await run('lifecycleTrace'),null,2));
